general_information.Description: In this course, students are introduced to a comprehensive 14-step process designed to address real-world, human-centered challenges of their own selection. Through a project-based, experiential learning approach, students will develop and demonstrate proficiency in the core competencies of Design Thinking. The curriculum emphasizes the application of key human-centered design tools to facilitate idea generation and foster meaningful engagement with end-users. Furthermore, students will critically engage with six fundamental phases of the design thinking process, examining the associated shifts in cognitive frameworks and skill development required at each stage.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course(s) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in the courses, regularly study the course at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 4. Keep up with online learning progress (bonus will be awarded) 5. Communicate and discuss in forum 6. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional) 7. Must complete the course(s) with certification(s) in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Theoretical Exam (TE) 3) Final Result (FR) = min (10, TE + Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

Possess the ability to master media tools and communication methodologies through hands-on, project-based experiences.
Attain a deep and critical understanding of foundational and emerging concepts in media and communication studies.
